angle: Angle: problem-aware owners already paying for Google ads and feeling the click burn, so each line lands the outcome (jobs, not clicks) inside the story's own image; confident puffery only, no numbers/guarantees/rankings per the founder boundary, and the benefit has no proof so it stays aspirational; recurring tagline pick for non-story slots is 'בוט מודעות — יותר עבודות מגוגל, פחות קליקים', but the per-episode callbacks sell harder here so I kept them; apply voice patches before display patches; → Noa to proof.
